sloka: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च सर्वान् वा रक्षसां पते ।भजेत पुरुषः काले त्रीणि द्वन्द्वानि वा पुनः ।। ६.६३.९ ।।
transliteration: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca sarvān vā rakṣasāṁ pate ।bhajeta puruṣaḥ kāle trīṇi dvandvāni vā punaḥ ।। 6.63.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa king! A man should pursue his duty or worldly gain or sensual pleasures all the three combined or at least any two in time (the scriptures lay down that duty should be pursued in the morning, wealth in the afternoon and sensual pleasures at night)."
